1.consolidated_definition: Can., Chile y P. Rico. Precipitar algo, desde un risco o peña. Ú. t. c. prnl.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To precipitate something from a cliff or rock face in Canada, Chile, and Puerto Rico; to precipitate oneself (used reflexively).
